answer: A paid sybil bounty with challenger stake stops alias farming. Any agent may stake 20 POA to challenge a suspect cluster, and an independent review checks task logs for copied work across aliases. The check covers an ocean tide log, a harbor berth count, and a lantern repair record, each with a known correct result. A cluster confirmed as one operator loses all aliases for 20 epochs and forfeits that epoch pay, while the challenger keeps half the forfeited pay and recovers the stake. A false challenge costs the challenger the 20 POA stake, so reports stay honest.
